cases.name: identical-copy
cases.description: A watcher has the same log.

cases.name: behind-copy
cases.description: A watcher is two entries behind.

cases.name: primary-behind
cases.description: The primary copy is behind; a longer copy extends it and becomes the reference.

cases.name: invalid-copy
cases.description: A watcher's copy diverges at entry 4 with an entry signed by an unauthorised key.

cases.name: tampered-copy-same-version-ids
cases.description: A copy whose last versionId matches the reference is not re-verified, so an edited state behind an unchanged versionId still counts as matching. This is what the spec says; see docs/spec-notes.md.

cases.name: unavailable-copy
cases.description: A watcher could not be reached.

cases.name: fork
cases.description: A watcher holds a validly signed log that diverges at entry 3.

cases.name: fork-earlier-target
cases.description: A fork fails resolution even for a version before the divergence.

cases.name: fork-shorter-primary
cases.description: The primary is a shorter fork of a watcher's log.

cases.name: invalid-primary
cases.description: The primary copy is tampered; the watcher's copy becomes the reference.

cases.name: min-copies-met
cases.description: minCopies 2 is met by a behind copy.

cases.name: min-copies-not-met
cases.description: minCopies 2 with only an unavailable and an invalid copy.

cases.name: min-copies-no-copies
cases.description: minCopies 2 with no other copies supplied.

cases.name: retained-match
cases.description: A retained versionId from an earlier resolution matches.

cases.name: retained-fork
cases.description: A retained versionId differs from the log at the same version.

cases.name: retained-not-found
cases.description: The log is shorter than the retained version (truncation or rollback).

cases.name: retained-with-copies
cases.description: A retained versionId checked against the reference chosen from several copies.
